watchOut: Contract, recourse and other fees not stated on the page we read.
name: Orange Commercial Credit (OCC)
summary: Factoring for owner-operators and fleets across freight types, including dump trucks, reefers, flatbeds and tankers.
differentiator: Publishes the top of its range, 5%, which most factors leave out. At $10K a month that is $125 at the bottom and $500 at the top, so ask where your lanes and brokers put you before signing.

terms.rate: Our factoring discount fee can range from 1.25% - 5%
terms.advance: Up to 98% of the invoice within 24 hours for some industries
terms.speed: The advance usually funds within 24 hours

bestFor: Carriers in niche freight (dump, tanker, reefer) who want a factor that names them.
skipIf: You want contract and fee terms on the site; we found none.
